buyer: A small studio preparing one short product demonstration
job: Turn approved campaign notes into a reviewable production brief before generating media.

claims.text: Show one complete input-to-result journey: approved notes, a source-linked brief, an export and a human review.
The reference lab uses local Node.js and makes no network request or model call. It does not promise AI generation or saved time.
Use four deliberate chapters: Gather, Shape, Inspect, Own. Each scene reveals the actual artifact; cuts do not imply hidden automation.
Provide captions, legible source labels, pause and skip controls, a complete static transcript and optional audio that begins only after consent.
Use owned or licensed material. Do not show customer records, fabricate testimonials or portray proposed paid checkout as available.

nextActions: Inspect the original notes and identify any unsupported statement before producing media.
Capture the actual lab run and export; keep synthetic fixture labels visible.
Storyboard Gather as an input close-up, Shape as the artifact transformation, Inspect as source and boundary checks, and Own as the export handoff.
Ask a reviewer to inspect the output against every source and rights assertion before approving the brief.
